presentation.description: A battle-tested default for coding and general use. It trades some speed for the predictability and familiarity of llama.cpp.
A very compact model for general use.
Our smallest Gemma option for short text tasks and simple tool workflows.
A larger alternative to E2B for everyday text and tool tasks. Expected to offer better fidelity and broader knowledge at a higher memory cost.

exclude_engine_versions.reason: needs Splash 1.1.0 or newer: GGUF metadata derivation and architecture-matched DFlash2

presentation.description: Our top choice in size S for coding tasks. Combines Unsloth’s UD3.0 quantization with Splash and DFlash2, delivering up to twice llama.cpp’s throughput. Requires extra disk space for its native weight cache.
A companion for technical writing, planning and orchestration.
A lighter, faster alternative to Gemma 4 31B for creative writing and general conversation.

The larger Gemma option for creative writing and general conversation. Expected to offer better fidelity and broader knowledge than 26B-A4B, at the cost of speed. Uses Unsloth QAT weights on llama.cpp with plain decoding.
Extracts structured data from text and document images, and converts documents to Markdown. CPU keeps the GPU available for other models; GPU is faster and recommended for images.
A compact English reranker that runs on CPU, leaving the GPU available for other models.
A multilingual alternative to Ettin with a larger memory footprint. CPU keeps the GPU available for other models; GPU gives faster reranking.
The smallest TranslateGemma option, prioritizing translation speed and low memory use.
The middle TranslateGemma option, with better fidelity expected than 4B and lower memory use and faster responses than 27B.
The largest TranslateGemma option, offering the highest expected translation fidelity at the cost of speed and memory.
The balanced Tiny Aya option for translation across language regions. Includes translation to and from English.
Tiny Aya focused on European and Asia-Pacific languages, including Swedish, German, French, Chinese, Japanese and Korean. Includes translation to and from English.
Tiny Aya focused on South Asian languages, including Hindi, Bengali, Gujarati, Marathi, Tamil, Telugu and Nepali. Includes translation to and from English.
Tiny Aya focused on West Asian and African languages, including Arabic, Persian, Turkish, Hebrew, Swahili, Amharic, Hausa and Yoruba. Includes translation to and from English.
